is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae s.s. and An. arabiensis) in northern Uganda.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for the L1014S (kdr-east) mutation in An. gambiae s.s. (Table 2, page 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 on page 3 provides genotype counts (Homozygote mutation RR and Homozygote wild type SS) for An. gambiae s.s. across different insecticide exposures.

african_field_population.evidence: The study collected mosquitoes from field sites in northern Uganda (Kitgum, Lamwo, Agago, Gulu, Oyam, Pader).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field collection and laboratory analysis data.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies collection districts: Kitgum, Lamwo, Agago, Gulu, Oyam, and Pader (page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study reports collections in 2017, 2018, and February 2019 (page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes original field collections conducted by the authors.

supplement.evidence: The required genotype data is provided in Table 2 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study investigated insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.l. in northern Uganda. It reports susceptibility to malathion and bendiocarb, and resistance to deltamethrin and permethrin. Genotyping for the L1014S (kdr-east) mutation was performed, and genotype counts for survivors and dead mosquitoes are provided in Table 2.
